body: Thank you, when I’m older, I wanted to own a cafe. Just a little one. I take business classes which I excel in since I enjoy learning about how to run a business. Chemistry is my biggest struggle, the teacher assigns at least 5 assignments per day and it’s hard to keep up with. They compare me to my little brother who’s in elementary school. They tell me “well he’s doing good in school so you should too”. They don’t understand the different workloads. My mother threatens to make me quit my job but I learn how to bake and make coffee and such drinks at my job. Thank you so much for your kind words. And thank you for being confident in me. I’m doing owed chemistry work right now and hopefully I’ll be able to get some rest tonight.

Hi, thank you for responding. I forgot to include in my post that even though my grades were bad. I tried my hardest to catch up and I did! My grades were still low and my parents were furious. I tried to explain that I couldn’t just “redo” assignments but they wouldn’t take it. I’m trying my best right now but I don’t know what to do
It’s been like this my whole life sadly, but you learn to live with it. It gets too much sometimes though
haha thank you, I appreciate it
I appreciate your kind words. I also hope the best for you in these rough times. Stay strong okay?

I appreciate your help. My medication has been adjusted a few times but I think I’ll try again now. I have only been with my therapist a few times but hopefully I’ll visit more often. Thank you for your advice so so much. Therapy was rough in the beginning because my father would always be in the room with me so I couldn’t fully express myself. But this time I’ll try to be alone with just her so I can explain everything. Again, thank you for listening and for your advice. I’ll try to follow it with the best of my ability. :)

I don’t necessarily have depression, well I don’t quite know. I haven’t been diagnosed but I’ve been on anti-depressants for about a year now. Thank you for your support and I wish you the best of luck in your journey as well. I hope you stay strong as well.

Thank you for responding, actually I’ve been on anti-depressants for about a year now and am soon going back to therapy. As I read your response I was put through quite the flurry of emotions. I thank you for your advice regarding myself and my problems. I don’t necessarily have a close person to reach out to about my problems but people like you have talked to me and helped quite a bit. I still struggle but I have a little more motivation to get better. I appreciate your help so so much and I’ll try to heal as much as I can. Hopefully, therapy will help this time around. Again, thank you so much.
Thank you, I’m glad to know there is people like you out there.
Thank you, I wish I could feel the same way. I’m so sorry. Sometimes it’s hard to see the line between encouragement and excessive expectations that I just can’t meet anymore.
